description: generateContent(editor, [], false) from @lexical/devtools-core: the playground's tree view of the editor state (with marks and named slots), its selection and the editor's flags; and, once per document, generateContent(editor, [], true), its exportDOM form, in jsdom. The selection is set after the state is parsed (a path's strings name slots); Swift prints its own LexicalEditor.version in place of `version`.
